messages:
amanda: Quick heads-up — spike during perf testing: console route-heatmap parser threw on a few high-TPS requests. Looks like TS/Py SDKs started sending route headers as compact binary (base64 payload) instead of JSON in some builds. Anyone owning SDK encoding change?
ben: I saw that. Which header exactly? example?
amanda: header is `X-Redwood-Route`. Old form was JSON string: `{\"policy\":\"latency\",\"tier\":\"dedicated\"}`. New form is compact CBOR-like blob base64-encoded. e.g. `X-Redwood-Route: pG...` (base64). Console expects JSON and chokes when it can't parse.
claire: We intentionally switched to a compact binary encoding to shave bytes on high-throughput paths — saves ~20% request size at 100ms latency budgets. Console parsing was supposed to be backward-compatible; clearly a gap.
daniel: This is a compatibility break for embedded clients. Suggest: (1) server accept both encodings for a grace period, (2) SDKs ship an opt-in flag for the new encoding, and (3) Console does detection/fallback.
emily: Runtime can accept both for a short window. I'll add a decoder that tries: 1) try binary/cbor (base64), 2) fallback to JSON. But we need telemetry to see adoption rate per encoding. Add metric `route.header.encoding` with tags `encoding:json|b64|cbor`.
ben: I'll open PRs for python and ts today. Proposed SDK default: keep JSON for now, add `use_compact_routeheaders: true` opt-in in the next major, then flip default in 2 weeks once telemetry stable. Thoughts?
amanda: Sounds reasonable. Also add a `route_header_compat` feature-flag on the server side so we can flip accept-only-json if needed. Devex will prepare migration docs and a Console banner.
claire: Console patch is small — implement detect-and-parse. Also add a dashboard tile showing per-encoding counts and avg header size so product can see token/quota impact. Mockup: https://redwood.internal/console/mocks/route-encoding-tile (WIP).
daniel: Messaging note: the Console banner should say something like: "Route header encoding is changing — compact encoding reduces request size and may change quota accounting. Toggle migration setting in SDKs." Need product signoff on the wording.
emily: For telemetry, log example event: `metric.increment('route.header.encoding', {'encoding':'json'})` and emit a trace tag `route.header.encoding=json`. We'll also emit a small histogram for header_size_bytes.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: `route-header-decoder-v2` -> prod/us-west (canary 5%).
ben: FYI I'll include a backwards-compat test matrix: server_accepts(b64|json), sdk_sends(json|b64), console_parses(json|b64). I'll tag you all on the PR.
amanda: Great — Ben, assign PR to me. Claire/Emily/Daniel, can we aim to have server fallback + telemetry live before canary reaches 100%?
emily: Yes, I'll prioritize the telemetry + fallback decoder. ETA end of day.
daniel: I'll draft the migration doc + Console banner copy and drop in #product-review for approval.
amanda: Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
